name: Workable
tagline: Workable is an all-in-one recruiting and HR platform that uses AI to source candidates, screen applications, and streamline the hiring process. Its AI Recruiter feature automatically suggests candidates from a database of 400 million+ profiles and helps evaluate applicants against job requirements.
